module.name: Commands
config.extreme_aliases.desc: Adds one or two letter aliases such as /f ub and /g i. Takes effect after a restart.
config.aliases.desc: Extra top-level commands. The key is the new name and the value is the command it runs, for example name = factory name. Takes effect after a restart.
config.long_chat.desc: Lets you type more than 256 characters in chat. NBT Editor commands get the full text. Anything sent to the server is still cut to 256 characters, and a warning shows when that will happen.
command.new: Puts a new item in your empty hand and edits it
command.snbt: Gives you an item from SNBT
command.tab: Opens the %s tab for the held item or the block or entity you're looking at
help.title: NBT Editor commands
help.more: Run /nbt with nothing after it to edit the held item or what you're looking at.
help.click: Click to fill in the command
item.too_many: You can get at most %s at once.
credits.title: NBT Editor by nick22985
credits.original: Built on the original NBT Editor by mega12345mega.
credits.heads: Heads in /get hdb come from minecraft-heads.com.
